title: Shopify Custom app access token and Shopify Public app access token: must be flagged
summary: Synthetic Shopify Custom app access token and Shopify Public app access token values built to the documented format appear in 3 inputs in environment files, HTTP headers, and source code. Each input records the exact byte range of the secret.
rationale: A credential that a scanner misses in an ordinary carrier is leaked. Carriers differ in quoting, delimiters and surrounding text, so a hit on one carrier does not show coverage of another.

expectation.rationale: Token shape is plausible, but the shop domain the contract requires is absent.
